'''Ulla Drelliad''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Considered by many to be voluptuous, quick-witted, and Ord Mantell's most celebrated smuggler, Drelliad established a private retreat on the island of [[Avilatan]]. After her [[Death/Legends|death]], Drelliad's retreat was converted into a trading post that thrived and eventually developed into [[Drelliad village]], with the smuggler's personal [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] used by the village's inhabitants as one of the few landing pads outside of the nearby [[Fort Garnik]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ulla Drelliad was mentioned in the Codex entry for Drelliad village in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
